fields.topology_type: Source-synchronous parallel memory bus. Controller (master) drives clock + command + address to one or more DDR3 SDRAM devices (slaves). DIMM modules use fly-by routing for command / address / control with end-of-line termination (replacing the T-branch routing of DDR2).

supported_topologies.name: Single controller + single DRAM component
supported_topologies.description: Point-to-point board topology (FPGA / SoC / embedded). One DRAM x4 / x8 / x16 directly soldered or in a socket. No fly-by skew.

supported_topologies.name: Single controller + single rank DDR3 UDIMM
supported_topologies.description: Unbuffered DIMM (UDIMM) for desktop / workstation. One rank, fly-by routing of CA / CTRL across multiple x8 DRAMs. Write Leveling required.

supported_topologies.name: Single controller + dual rank DDR3 UDIMM
supported_topologies.description: Two ranks selected via CS0# / CS1# / ODT0 / ODT1; same fly-by routing.

supported_topologies.name: Single controller + single / dual rank DDR3 SO-DIMM
supported_topologies.description: Small Outline DIMM for notebook / embedded; same protocol as UDIMM, smaller form factor.

supported_topologies.name: Single controller + DDR3 RDIMM
supported_topologies.description: Registered DIMM (server): register chip latches CA and re-drives to DRAMs (+1 cycle CA latency); permits more ranks per channel.

supported_topologies.name: Single controller + DDR3 LRDIMM
supported_topologies.description: Load-Reduced DIMM: memory buffer chip buffers both CA and DQ; permits up to 4 ranks per channel at higher data rates.

supported_topologies.name: Single controller + multi-DIMM channel
supported_topologies.description: Two or three DIMM slots per channel; ranks selected via CS# encoding.

supported_topologies.name: Stacked / dual-die / quad-die packages
supported_topologies.description: Multiple DRAM dies in one package with CKE0/CKE1, CS0#..CS3#, ODT0/ODT1, ZQ0..ZQ3 per die.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Generates CK / CK# and CKE; issues all commands; tracks per-bank state; manages refresh, ZQ calibration, Write Leveling, Read Leveling; sources DQ on writes and sinks DQ on reads.

Decodes commands per Command Truth Table; opens / closes rows; sources DQ on reads and sinks DQ on writes; maintains internal refresh during Self-Refresh; provides feedback for Write Leveling and ZQ calibration.
Re-drives CA / CTRL signals on registered DIMMs; adds +1 cycle CA latency. JEDEC JESD82-XX standard.
Re-drives DQ signals on Load-Reduced DIMMs; reduces electrical load on DDR3 channel.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no DDR3-protocol-layer interconnect (no router / bridge). The bus is a flat 1-controller : N-rank bus. Rank selection is via CS# (one per rank); within a rank, bank selection is via BA[2:0]; within a bank, row/column is via A[15:0]. On RDIMM/LRDIMM the on-DIMM register / buffer chip is a fan-out repeater, not a protocol router.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_burst: 8 (BL8) or 4 (BC4) beats in the order determined by MR0 A3 (RBT) and the column-address LSBs A[2:0] per Table 3 — Burst Type and Burst Order.
ordering_guarantees.across_commands: Commands are committed in the order issued by the controller; there is no command reordering at the DRAM. tCCD between successive column commands, tRRD/tFAW between successive activates, etc., serialize commands on the wire.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: The DDR3 SDRAM exposes a single linear DRAM array as a 3D address space (bank × row × column). Mode Register Set and ZQ Calibration use the same command bus but do not access the DRAM array.

device_classification.removable_DIMM: DDR3 UDIMM / SO-DIMM / RDIMM / LRDIMM — keyed connector; can be replaced.
device_classification.embedded_component: Standalone DDR3 x4 / x8 / x16 DRAM soldered on a board (embedded / industrial / automotive).
device_classification.DDR3_controller: Controller IP integrated into the SoC / FPGA / CPU memory controller.
device_classification.DIMM_register_chip: Register / RCD on RDIMM / LRDIMM modules.
device_classification.DIMM_buffer_chip: Memory Buffer / MB on LRDIMM modules.
